name: Neighbeats
description: Pick two tracks (or one, for "similar") and neighbeats builds a real Jellyfin playlist for the user who asked, routing or finding neighbours in its own index. neighbeats never writes to Jellyfin; this plugin owns the playlist.
overview: Build real Jellyfin playlists from neighbeats routes and similarity
